name: Fluid Density Calculator
description: Calculate fluid density from SG (specific gravity) or API gravity, with temperature correction for water.

seo.title: Fluid Density Calculator - SG API
seo.description: Calculate fluid density from specific gravity, API gravity, or Baume scale for oils, chemicals, and process fluids.

formula.explanation: ρ = SG × ρ_water = SG × 1000 kg/m³. Specific gravity is the ratio of fluid density to water at 4°C.

content.introduction: Convert specific gravity to density in kg/m³. Essential for hydraulic calculations, pump sizing, and mass flow conversions. Includes common fluid SG values.

example.description: Crude oil with SG=0.85 has density 850 kg/m³.

faq.a: API = (141.5/SG) − 131.5. Water has API 10°. Light oils have high API; heavy oils have low API. SG=0.85 → API=35°.
Most fluids expand when heated, reducing density. Water: ~1000 kg/m³ at 4°C, ~998 at 20°C, ~958 at 100°C. Use operating temperature densities for accurate pump calcs.
